chapters.title: The five building blocks of an image build

takeaways: Azure Image Builder turns hand-built golden images into a repeatable process driven by an image template with a source, customizations, validation, distribution and versioning.
Azure Compute Gallery organizes images into definitions and versions, replicates them to regions and enables rollback to a known good version.
Most build failures come from permissions, network access, policies and scripts, so use a least-access managed identity, silent scripts and the Packer logs to troubleshoot.
hook: Hand-built virtual machine images drift, depend on one admin's memory and break when steps are skipped. This episode explains Azure Image Builder and Azure Compute Gallery for Azure administrators and Azure Virtual Desktop teams. You learn how to build, validate, version and distribute the same approved image every time.
